title: Recognize arcs
tagline: Find spline edges that a single circular arc represents within a tolerance -- report them, and optionally rebuild the wire with true arcs so Onshape shows their radius.

slides.title: What it does
slides.problem: Imported and fitted curves carry arcs as splines: clicking them shows no radius, and drawings and CAM cannot use them as arcs. Recognize arcs asks of each spline 'is this really one arc?' and, where it is, puts a true sketch arc in its place.
useWhen: A spline that should report a radius
Check which edges of a wire are really arcs
Before drawings or CAM that need arcs
slides.caption: R1: a spline through 9 points of R100 is replaced; R5's coarse spline is not.

points.head: One arc, never a biarc
points.body: The circle through both ends and the best interior sample must be within tolerance at all 64 samples.

points.head: Ends agree
points.body: Both end directions within Max end tangent change of the circle's -- the kink a replacement can add.

points.head: Connected
points.body: The arc passes exactly through the edge's ends; lines and arcs pass through unchanged.

slides.title: The dialog
params: The edges or wire bodies to examine (only splines are candidates).
Largest distance between the spline and its arc (0.01 mm).
On: build a copy with true arcs. Off: report and highlight only.
Delete input wire bodies once the copy is built.

slides.title: Example: a line-arc-line chain (R2)
slides.head: Line, spline on R200 (30 deg), line -> line, arc R200, line
slides.body: One wire of 3 edges, joints within the 0.05 deg allowance. Also tested: R1 -> arc R100.002; R3 (S-curve) and R5 (coarse) stay splines; R4 report only -> no body.

keys: The rebuilt wire(s) (when Replace with arcs is on).
messages: N of M spline edges are arcs ... (deviation and tangent change per candidate)

items.head: Report first
items.body: Turn Replace off to see which edges qualify and by how much.

items.head: Kinks
items.body: A replacement can add up to Max end tangent change at a joint -- keep it small.

rows: Arc tangency tests: R1-R5 (9/9 incl. P12/P13, M1/M2)
